title: A Trust Model Based on Service Classification in Mobile Services
review_status: sample dispositioned as metadata/abstract checked; full text unavailable in this session; not counted as full-text audit
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2010-11-13; IEEE/ACM GreenCom/CPSCom 2010, DOI 10.1109/GreenCom-CPSCom.2010.19
evidence_note: Abstract proposes an intermediary trust operator, service-sensitivity classes, trust bands, authentication histories, and penalties. Full paper could not be retrieved; indexed snippets are not treated as validated experimental evidence.

title: Decentralized Multi-agent Plan Repair in Dynamic Environments
review_status: full-text audit complete; communication savings and counterexamples across coordination/failure conditions checked; simulated domains and implementation limits recorded
sections_checked: results across logistics, rovers, perturbation, and satellite conditions
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2012-02-13; full version of AAMAS 2012 extended abstract
evidence_note: Three-agent simulated logistics/action-failure results report average message counts at 59% and 43% of replanning for two repair methods. Gains weaken in loosely coordinated settings and disappear for one randomized-state perturbation; evaluation limited to plans with at most two landmarks. No physical robot trial.

title: A Picture is Worth a Thousand Words: Language Models Plan from Pixels
review_status: full-text audit complete; benchmark results, simulator task validity issue, normalization, and transfer limitation checked
evidence_note: VP2 reports VizALF ID/OD 55.3/27.8% and VirtualHome ID/OD 20.6/7.5%. Authors identify 64/187 ID and 52/190 OD ALFWorld tasks as impossible due to simulator low-level action bugs and normalize by oracle success. Evidence is simulated, not a real-robot reliability test.

title: FlowState: Execution State as Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
review_status: full-text audit complete; state representation, MemoryArena/tau3-Bench results, endpoint tradeoff, cross-model scope, ethics, and reproducibility statement checked
sections_checked: Appendix B.5 task sets, configurations, and baselines
evidence_note: Reports improved selected MemoryArena task metrics and 43.2% fewer tokens than full context with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. tau3-Bench Retail action accuracy falls 4.9 points even as pass rate/database accuracy improve. Other memory baselines mainly use one backbone; full code is promised later. Authors state benchmarks do not establish deployment safety and warn of sensitive/stale retained data.

title: STALE: Can LLM Agents Know When Their Memories Are No Longer Valid?
review_status: citation follow-up full-text audit complete; benchmark construction, evaluation, judge validation, limitations, and CUPMem results checked
sections_checked: §1-2 implicit conflict taxonomy and related work
Appendix A limitations and Appendix E human-judge validation
evidence_note: 400 expert-validated conflict scenarios and 1,200 queries. Gemini-3.1-pro scores 55.2% overall, with 92% on Type-I state resolution but 30% on Type-I premise resistance. Automatic evaluator agreement with humans is 95.83% (kappa 0.9152) on 240 responses. Controlled one-shot, LLM-generated scenarios limit ecological validity; CUPMem result is not an independent replication.
